32	CACHE_DIR = Path(
33	    os.path.expanduser(
34	        os.environ.get(
35	            "TEXT_CLASSIFICATION_LLM_CACHE_DIR",
36	            "~/.cache/text-classification/litellm",
37	        )

41	KNOWN_PROVIDER_PREFIXES = (

59	_HARMONY_ENC = None

62	def _get_harmony_enc():
63	    """Lazy-load harmony encoder to avoid import overhead when not using GPT-OSS."""
64	    global _HARMONY_ENC
65	    if _HARMONY_ENC is None:
66	        _HARMONY_ENC = load_harmony_encoding(HarmonyEncodingName.HARMONY_GPT_OSS)
67	    return _HARMONY_ENC
68	
69	
70	def parse_harmony_response(raw_content: str) -> str:
71	    """Parse GPT-OSS harmony format, extracting final channel content.
72	
73	    Returns the 'final' channel content, or raw content if parsing fails.
74	    """
75	    enc = _get_harmony_enc()
76	    try:
77	        tokens = enc.encode(raw_content, allowed_special="all")
78	        parsed = enc.parse_messages_from_completion_tokens(
79	            tokens, role=Role.ASSISTANT, strict=False
80	        )
81	
82	        for msg in parsed:
83	            if msg.channel == "final":
84	                return "".join(c.text for c in msg.content if hasattr(c, "text"))
85	
86	        if parsed:
87	            return "".join(c.text for c in parsed[-1].content if hasattr(c, "text"))
88	    except Exception:
89	        pass
90	
91	    return raw_content
92	
93	
94	def _is_retryable(exc: Exception) -> bool:
95	    status = (
96	        getattr(exc, "status_code", None)
97	        or getattr(exc, "code", None)
98	        or getattr(exc, "status", None)
99	    )
100	    if status == 429 or (isinstance(status, int) and 500 <= status < 600):
101	        return True
102	    text = str(exc).lower()
103	    return any(
104	        token in text
105	        for token in (
106	            "429",
107	            "rate limit",
108	            "too many requests",
109	            "retry in",
110	            "timed out",
111	            "timeout",
112	            "connection error",
113	        )
114	    )
115	
116	
117	def _completion_cost_usd(response: Any, usage: Any, allow_price_table: bool) -> float:
118	    """Prefer the provider's own cost, then LiteLLM's price table."""
119	    reported = []
120	    if usage is not None:
121	        reported.append(getattr(usage, "cost", None))
122	        extra = getattr(usage, "model_extra", None) or {}
123	        if isinstance(extra, dict):
124	            reported.append(extra.get("cost"))
125	    hidden = getattr(response, "_hidden_params", None) or {}
126	    if isinstance(hidden, dict):
127	        reported.append(hidden.get("response_cost"))
128	    for value in reported:
129	        if value is None:
130	            continue
131	        try:
132	            return float(value)
133	        except (TypeError, ValueError):
134	            continue
135	    if not allow_price_table:
136	        return 0.0
137	    try:
138	        return float(completion_cost(completion_response=response) or 0.0)
139	    except Exception:
140	        return 0.0
141	
142	
143	def _extract_content(response: Any) -> str:
144	    message = response.choices[0].message
145	    content = getattr(message, "content", None)
146	    if isinstance(content, str):
147	        return content
148	    if isinstance(content, list):
149	        parts = []
150	        for item in content:
151	            if isinstance(item, dict) and "text" in item:
152	                parts.append(item["text"])
153	            elif hasattr(item, "text"):
154	                parts.append(item.text)
155	        return "".join(parts)
156	    return ""

159	class LLMCallable(Protocol):
160	    """Protocol for LLM call functions."""
161	
162	    def __call__(self, prompt: str) -> str: ...

165	class ProviderLLM:
166	    """Thin shim that provides the old provider interface on top of litellm."""
167	
168	    def __init__(
169	        self,
170	        model: str,
171	        max_concurrent: int = 4,
172	        api_key: str | None = None,
173	        api_base: str | None = None,
174	        cache_mode: str | None = None,
175	        cache_dir: str | Path | None = None,
176	    ):
177	        self.model = model
178	        self.api_key = api_key
179	        self.api_base = api_base
180	        self.cache_mode = cache_mode or os.environ.get("TEXT_CLASSIFICATION_LLM_CACHE_MODE", "run")
181	        supplied_cache = cache_dir or os.environ.get("TEXT_CLASSIFICATION_LLM_CACHE_DIR")
182	        if self.cache_mode not in {"off", "run"}:
183	            raise ValueError("Pilot cache mode must be off or run")
184	        if self.cache_mode == "run" and not supplied_cache:
185	            raise ValueError("run cache requires an explicit isolated cache directory")
186	        self.cache_dir = Path(supplied_cache) if supplied_cache else None
187	        self.logical_calls = 0
188	        self.api_requests = 0
189	        self.cache_hits = 0
190	        self.failed_requests = 0
191	        self.total_input_tokens = 0
192	        self.total_output_tokens = 0
193	        self.total_cost = 0.0
194	        self._usage_lock = threading.Lock()
195	        self._cache_lock = threading.Lock()
196	        self._executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_concurrent)
197	        if self.cache_mode == "run":
198	            self.cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
199	
200	    def __exit__(self, *exc):
201	        self._executor.shutdown(wait=True)
202	        return False
203	
204	    def _normalized_model(self) -> str:
205	        if self.api_base and not self.model.startswith(KNOWN_PROVIDER_PREFIXES):
206	            return f"openai/{self.model}"
207	        return self.model
208	
209	    def _cache_path(
210	        self, prompt: str, system_prompt: str | None, kwargs: dict[str, Any]
211	    ) -> Path:
212	        payload = {
213	            "version": CACHE_VERSION,
214	            "model": self._normalized_model(),
215	            "api_base": self.api_base,
216	            "system_prompt": system_prompt,
217	            "prompt": prompt,
218	            "kwargs": kwargs,
219	        }
220	        digest = hashlib.sha256(
221	            json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode("utf-8")
222	        ).hexdigest()
223	        return (self.cache_dir or Path(".")) / f"{digest}.json"
224	
225	    def _load_cache(self, path: Path) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
226	        if not path.exists():
227	            return None
228	        try:
229	            return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
230	        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
231	            return None
232	
233	    def _save_cache(self, path: Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
234	        tmp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
235	        try:
236	            with self._cache_lock:
237	                tmp.write_text(json.dumps(payload), encoding="utf-8")
238	                tmp.replace(path)
239	        except OSError:
240	            pass
241	
242	    def _call_completion(
243	        self, prompt: str, system_prompt: str | None, kwargs: dict[str, Any]
244	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
245	        messages = []
246	        if system_prompt:
247	            messages.append({"role": "system", "content": system_prompt})
248	        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": prompt})
249	
250	        call_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
251	        call_kwargs["timeout"] = 600.0
252	        if self.api_base:
253	            call_kwargs["base_url"] = self.api_base
254	            call_kwargs.setdefault("api_key", self.api_key or "local")
255	        elif self.api_key is not None:
256	            call_kwargs["api_key"] = self.api_key
257	
258	        model = self._normalized_model()
259	        # Retries are counted here by _generate_one; disable hidden SDK retries.
260	        response = litellm_completion(model=model, messages=messages, num_retries=0, **call_kwargs)
261	        content = _extract_content(response)
262	
263	        usage = getattr(response, "usage", None)
264	        input_tokens = getattr(usage, "prompt_tokens", None)
265	        output_tokens = getattr(usage, "completion_tokens", None)
266	        if input_tokens is None:
267	            try:
268	                input_tokens = token_counter(model=model, messages=messages)
269	            except Exception:
270	                input_tokens = 0
271	        if output_tokens is None:
272	            try:
273	                output_tokens = token_counter(model=model, text=content)
274	            except Exception:
275	                output_tokens = 0
276	
277	        cost = _completion_cost_usd(response, usage, allow_price_table=not self.api_base)
278	        raw_usage = usage.model_dump() if hasattr(usage, "model_dump") else {}
279	        provider_cost = raw_usage.get("cost")
280	        raw_response = {
281	            "id": getattr(response, "id", None),
282	            "model": getattr(response, "model", None),
283	            "choices": [c.model_dump() if hasattr(c, "model_dump") else str(c) for c in response.choices],
284	            "usage": raw_usage,
285	        }
286	
287	        return {
288	            "content": content,
289	            "input_tokens": int(input_tokens or 0),
290	            "output_tokens": int(output_tokens or 0),
291	            "cost": cost,
292	            "reported_usd": float(provider_cost) if provider_cost is not None else None,
293	            "estimated_usd": cost if provider_cost is None else None,
294	            "cost_source": "provider_usage" if provider_cost is not None else "litellm_estimate",
295	            "raw_response": raw_response,
296	            "provider_usage": raw_usage,
297	        }
298	
299	    def _generate_one(
300	        self, prompt: str, system_prompt: str | None, kwargs: dict[str, Any]
301	    ) -> str:
302	        started = time.monotonic()
303	        call_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
304	        call = {"call_id": call_id, "model": self._normalized_model(), "prompt": prompt,
305	                "system_prompt": system_prompt, "parameters": kwargs, "cache_mode": self.cache_mode}
306	        with self._usage_lock:
307	            self.logical_calls += 1
308	        cache_path = self._cache_path(prompt, system_prompt, kwargs)
309	        cached = self._load_cache(cache_path) if self.cache_mode == "run" else None
310	        if cached is not None:
311	            with self._usage_lock:
312	                self.cache_hits += 1
313	            record_call({**call, "event": "cache_hit", "content": cached["content"],
314	                         "raw_response": cached.get("raw_response"), "cost": 0.0,
315	                         "wall_seconds": time.monotonic() - started})
316	            return cached["content"]
317	
318	        result = None
319	        for attempt in range(4):  # One initial request and at most three retries.
320	            attempt_id = f"{call_id}:{attempt}"
321	            attempt_start = time.monotonic()
322	            record_call({**call, "event": "api_started", "attempt_id": attempt_id, "attempt": attempt})
323	            with self._usage_lock:
324	                self.api_requests += 1
325	            try:
326	                result = self._call_completion(prompt, system_prompt, kwargs)
327	            except Exception as exc:
328	                with self._usage_lock:
329	                    self.failed_requests += 1
330	                status = getattr(exc, "status_code", None)
331	                record_call({**call, "event": "api_failed", "attempt_id": attempt_id,
332	                             "error_type": type(exc).__name__, "http_status": status,
333	                             "cost": None, "cost_source": "unreported_failure",
334	                             "wall_seconds": time.monotonic() - attempt_start})
335	                if status in (401, 403) or attempt == 3 or not _is_retryable(exc):
336	                    raise
337	                time.sleep(min(32, 2 ** (attempt + 1)))
338	                continue
339	            record_call({**call, **result, "event": "api_result", "attempt_id": attempt_id,
340	                         "wall_seconds": time.monotonic() - attempt_start})
341	            break
342	        if self.cache_mode == "run":
343	            self._save_cache(cache_path, result)
344	
345	        with self._usage_lock:
346	            self.total_input_tokens += result["input_tokens"]
347	            self.total_output_tokens += result["output_tokens"]
348	            self.total_cost += result["cost"]
349	
350	        return result["content"]
351	
352	    def generate(self, prompts, system_prompt: str | None = None, **kwargs):
353	        if isinstance(prompts, str):
354	            return [[self._generate_one(prompts, system_prompt, kwargs)]]
355	
356	        prompts = list(prompts)
357	        if not prompts:
358	            return []
359	
360	        results = [None] * len(prompts)
361	        futures = {
362	            submit_with_context(self._executor,
363	                self._generate_one, prompt, system_prompt, kwargs
364	            ): idx
365	            for idx, prompt in enumerate(prompts)
366	        }
367	        for future in as_completed(futures):
368	            idx = futures[future]
369	            results[idx] = future.result()
370	        return [[content] for content in results]
371	
372	
373	class LLM:
374	    """LLM caller backed by litellm. Handles caching, batching, retries."""
375	
376	    def __init__(
377	        self,
378	        model: str = "openrouter/openai/gpt-oss-120b",
379	        api_key: str | None = None,
380	        api_base: str | None = None,
381	        temperature: float | None = None,
382	        max_tokens: int = 16384,
383	        max_workers: int = 32,
384	        cache_mode: str | None = None,
385	        cache_dir: str | Path | None = None,
386	    ):
387	        self.model = model
388	        self.is_gpt_oss = "gpt-oss" in model.lower()
389	
390	        if temperature is not None:
391	            self.temperature = temperature
392	        elif "gpt-5" in model or self.is_gpt_oss:
393	            self.temperature = 1.0
394	        else:
395	            self.temperature = 0.0
396	
397	        if api_base is not None and not self.is_gpt_oss and max_tokens > 4096:
398	            max_tokens = 4096
399	        self.max_tokens = max_tokens
400	
401	        self._model_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
402	            "temperature": self.temperature,
403	            "max_tokens": self.max_tokens,
404	        }
405	
406	        self._system_prompt = "Reasoning: medium" if self.is_gpt_oss else None
407	
408	        if api_base is None and max_workers > 4:
409	            max_workers = 4
410	        self._provider = ProviderLLM(
411	            model=model,
412	            max_concurrent=max_workers,
413	            api_key=api_key,
414	            api_base=api_base,
415	            cache_mode=cache_mode,
416	            cache_dir=cache_dir,
417	        )
418	
419	        self._usage_lock = threading.Lock()
420	        self.total_calls = 0
421	
422	    def __enter__(self):
423	        return self
424	
425	    def __exit__(self, *exc):
426	        if hasattr(self._provider, "__exit__"):
427	            self._provider.__exit__(*exc)
428	        return False
429	
430	    @property
431	    def total_input_tokens(self):
432	        return self._provider.total_input_tokens
433	
434	    @property
435	    def total_output_tokens(self):
436	        return self._provider.total_output_tokens
437	
438	    @property
439	    def total_cost(self):
440	        return self._provider.total_cost
441	
442	    def _truncate(self, prompt: str) -> str:
443	        if len(prompt) > MAX_PROMPT_CHARS:
444	            original_len = len(prompt)
445	            half = MAX_PROMPT_CHARS // 2
446	            prompt = prompt[:half] + "\n\n... [TRUNCATED] ...\n\n" + prompt[-half:]
447	            logger.warning(
448	                "Prompt truncated: %d -> %d chars (limit %d)",
449	                original_len,
450	                len(prompt),
451	                MAX_PROMPT_CHARS,
452	            )
453	        return prompt
454	
455	    def __call__(self, prompt: str) -> str:
456	        """Single prompt call."""
457	        prompt = self._truncate(prompt)
458	
459	        results = self._provider.generate(
460	            prompt, system_prompt=self._system_prompt, **self._model_kwargs
461	        )
462	        content = results[0][0]
463	
464	        with self._usage_lock:
465	            self.total_calls += 1
466	
467	        if self.is_gpt_oss:
468	            content = parse_harmony_response(content)
469	        return content
470	
471	    def get_usage(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
472	        """Return token usage stats and estimated cost."""
473	        with self._usage_lock:
474	            calls = self.total_calls
475	        return {
476	            "model": self.model,
477	            "calls": calls,
478	            "input_tokens": self.total_input_tokens,
479	            "output_tokens": self.total_output_tokens,
480	            "total_tokens": self.total_input_tokens + self.total_output_tokens,
481	            "estimated_cost_usd": round(self.total_cost, 4),
482	            "cost_usd_unrounded": self.total_cost,
483	            "logical_calls": self._provider.logical_calls,
484	            "api_requests": self._provider.api_requests,
485	            "cache_hits": self._provider.cache_hits,
486	            "failed_requests": self._provider.failed_requests,
487	        }
488	
489	    def reset_usage(self):
490	        """Reset token counters."""
491	        with self._usage_lock:
492	            self.total_calls = 0
493	        self._provider.total_input_tokens = 0
494	        self._provider.total_output_tokens = 0
495	        self._provider.total_cost = 0.0
496	        self._provider.logical_calls = 0
497	        self._provider.api_requests = 0
498	        self._provider.cache_hits = 0
499	        self._provider.failed_requests = 0
500	
501	    def batch(self, prompts: list[str]) -> list[str]:
502	        """Parallel batch call. Returns results in same order as prompts."""
503	        if not prompts:
504	            return []
505	
506	        prompts = [self._truncate(p) for p in prompts]
507	        results = self._provider.generate(
508	            prompts, system_prompt=self._system_prompt, **self._model_kwargs
509	        )
510	        contents = [r[0] for r in results]
511	
512	        with self._usage_lock:
513	            self.total_calls += len(prompts)
514	
515	        if self.is_gpt_oss:
516	            contents = [parse_harmony_response(c) for c in contents]
517	        return contents
518	
519	
520	def make_local_llm(
521	    model: str = "gpt-oss-120b",
522	    host: str = os.environ.get("LOCAL_LLM_HOST", "localhost"),
523	    port: int = int(os.environ.get("LOCAL_LLM_PORT", "30000")),
524	    max_tokens: int = 4096,
525	    max_workers: int = 16,
526	) -> LLM:
527	    """Create a local LLM caller against an OpenAI-compatible server.
528	
529	    Usage:
530	        llm = make_local_llm()
531	        response = llm("Hello!")
532	    """
533	    return LLM(
534	        model=model,
535	        api_base=f"http://{host}:{port}/v1",
536	        max_tokens=max_tokens,
537	        max_workers=max_workers,
538	    )
539

541	def make_stub_llm(response: str = '{"reasoning": "stub", "final_answer": "stub"}'):
542	    """Create a stub LLM caller for testing."""
543	    return lambda prompt: response
